metric_definition: Same M09 load.request SSE parser in all arms. TTFT to first nonempty text chunk; TPOT between first and last nonempty text chunks divided by API completion_tokens minus one. Throughput is successful requests divided by wall time, excluding warmup; report output-token throughput separately. Synthetic token inputs test scheduling, not semantic quality.

correctness_prompts.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer with only the city name.
What is 2 + 2? Answer with a single digit.
